name: threat-stack
description: A stack of threat-intelligence tools, growing from one trusted core. The anchor is skillsentry — a pure, never-executing, zero-dependency static auditor for AI-agent skills and plugins (the npx CLI, shipped self-contained in-repo). Around it: an agentic threat-modeler that maps every probe onto STRIDE portals + two EXTRA agentic axes (temporal, cognitive) and runs an Elevation-of-Privilege gap ritual that proposes new rules; a front-door concierge; and opt-in 'supersize' plugins that extend reach (e.g. Semgrep SAST) WITHOUT touching the auditor's zero-dep core. Each plugin stands alone; together they form a security platform whose deterministic core's guarantees are enforced by CI gates the agentic layer cannot bypass.

metadata.note: skillsentry is the trust anchor (defaultEnabled). The agentic plugins are opt-in (defaultEnabled:false) so enabling the platform never auto-runs non-deterministic code. The covenant proposes (PR); the deterministic core + a human dispose.

plugins.name: skillsentry
plugins.displayName: skillsentry — static supply-chain auditor (the trust anchor)
plugins.description: Audit an AI-agent skill or plugin for supply-chain attacks BEFORE it runs. A thin in-editor wrapper over the pure, never-executing, zero-dependency skillsentry CLI (shipped self-contained inside the plugin). /skillsentry:audit <target> runs the deterministic auditor over this repo or ANY other repo you are working on and renders a PASS / REVIEW / BLOCK verdict mapped to OWASP, MITRE ATLAS and STRIDE. The plugin NEVER reads-and-judges target files in the agent context — all detection stays inside the deterministic CLI, so auditing a hostile repo is safe.

plugins.name: threat-modeler
plugins.displayName: threat-modeler — STRIDE/EoP gap ritual & self-improvement covenant
plugins.description: The agentic threat-intelligence layer. Maps skillsentry's probe set onto STRIDE's six portals plus two EXTRA agentic axes (temporal, cognitive), runs the Elevation-of-Privilege 'threat-modelling poker' deck against the probes to surface ABSENT/THIN cells, and writes a gap analysis. Under the self-improvement covenant it drafts new deterministic RuleSpec data and OPENS A PR — it never decides a verdict and never ships a rule directly; the deterministic test suite and a human are the acceptance gate.

plugins.name: threat-stack
plugins.description: The front door of the threat-stack platform. Greets whoever opens the repo, explains the value flow (AUDIT ▸ MODEL ▸ EXTEND), lists only the installed plugins and the next command to run, and consolidates each plugin's readiness check into one table. A thin orchestrator that delegates to the specialists by capability and never re-implements them.

plugins.name: supersize-semgrep
plugins.description: An OPT-IN 'supersize' extension that adds Semgrep static analysis on top of skillsentry's verdict for deeper, language-aware SAST. A SEPARATE product with its own trust statement: it shells out to an external `semgrep` binary if installed (degrading gracefully with install guidance when absent) and is NEVER imported into the skillsentry core, so the auditor's zero-dependency, never-executing, deterministic guarantees remain unqualified. Off by default.
